**Found it: [refresh.js:15](src/auth/refresh.js:15) swallows the real error.**

Auth returns `invalid_grant` (token revoked), which isn't in `RECOVERABLE`. `refreshToken` then returns `undefined` instead of throwing.

[session.js:8](src/session.js:8) passes that `undefined` straight into `decode`, which crashes on `token.split` at [tokens.js:6](src/auth/tokens.js:6) — that's just where the bad value finally blows up.

Root cause is the silent `undefined` return in `refresh.js`, not the `.split` line the trace blames.
